source_note: Praetor 500/600 limitations for Kerry Wyatt's FO study (SIMCOM initial, Sep 29, 2026). Sources: Flexjet Crew Training Handbook EMB-545/550 Rev 2.5 (eff 03/04/2026) §5 'For Training Reference Only…see current AOM, QRH and AFM' plus §6, §7 and §10 answers; Flexjet Crew Flight Manual Rev 3.3; Praetor MEL Rev 14 (02-17-26); Embraer OB P550-001/23. No AFM/AOM/QRH was available, so every value is tagged verify_tag=true: check it against the AFM Section 2 / AOM Chapter 2 before relying on it. Page numbers are printed page numbers (CTH printed = PDF page; CFM printed = PDF page − 2). CTH §5 ITT/APU tables on pp.17–18 are images and were read by OCR of the page render. Where sources disagree, 'conflict' carries both values and the item says ask instructor; no value was chosen or invented.

items.value: Collins Pro Line Fusion FMS Operator's Guide P/N 523-0818863 must be immediately available when navigation is predicated on the FMS

items.label: Navigation database
items.value: Verify cycle is valid; FMS use limited to regions in the database; compare retrieved procedures with charts, don't use if different
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.19; CTH Rev 2.5 p.18

items.label: GPS use
items.value: Limited to airspace where GPS is approved; GNSS ALT/HT must not be used for altitude compliance

items.label: GPS-only approach
items.value: Before dispatch confirm predictive RAIM at destination ETA within approach criteria

items.label: LPV
items.value: Dual GPS required

items.label: LP approaches
items.value: Cannot be performed (Collins Pro Line Fusion limitation)

items.label: Non-GPS approach using FMS guidance
items.value: Procedure navaids and associated avionics (VOR, DME, ADF) must be operational

items.label: VOR/NDB approaches
items.value: FMS not authorized as nav source (monitor only); ground navaid data is final authority

items.label: Baro-VNAV
items.value: Prohibited below published minimums without visibility; prohibited with remote altimeter setting; prohibited outside chart temperature limits unless using VNAV temperature compensation

items.label: VNAV
items.value: FD required for VNAV operations

items.label: LNAV-only approaches
items.value: APPR button shall not be pressed (AFM 2-64); fly LNAV + VNAV per OpSpec C073

items.label: V-MDA approaches
items.value: VNAV only to the FAF; FPA or VS after the FAF
items.cite: CFM Rev 3.3 p.90; CFM Rev 3.3 p.92

items.label: ILS APPR button
items.value: Press only when heading deviation from ILS course < 90° and within 30 NM of destination

items.label: RNP lateral sensitivity
items.value: FMS sets lateral deviation sensitivity from RNP value in the nav database

items.label: RVSM compliant ADS
items.value: ADS 1, 2 and 3 compliant; SFIS must not be used; ADS X SLIPCOMP FAIL = not compliant

items.label: RVSM minimum equipment
items.value: 2 RVSM-compliant air data systems, 1 AP with ALT hold, 1 altitude alerter, 1 transponder; failure before RVSM entry → request new clearance

items.label: Approach category
items.value: Straight-in: P500 CAT B, P600 CAT C · All Flexjet aircraft circle as CAT C
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.19; CFM Rev 3.3 p.93

items.label: Steep approach
items.value: 4.5°–5.5° glidepath only on steep-approach-capable aircraft, but not authorized at Flexjet

items.label: Category II
items.value: Prohibited

items.label: Dual FMS TOLD
items.value: Approved (no AFM cross-check needed); no intermixing of AFM/OPERA/TOLD in a phase of flight; advisory only: AEO gradient, SID gradient, VAP, VFS

items.label: Magnetic heading accuracy / AHRS
items.value: Heading accuracy vs latitude table (AHRS AHC-4000) on page; not extracted

items.label: Aerobatics and spins
items.value: Prohibited

items.label: Ditching
items.value: Not certified for ditching (procedure exists in AFM)

items.label: Cabin interior doors
items.value: Secured open for taxi, takeoff and landing; galley/cabin door disabled OPEN (P600 AFM limitation)

items.label: Lavatory with emergency exit
items.value: Lav door secured and locked open for taxi, takeoff and landing

items.label: Divan
items.value: Not occupied for taxi/takeoff/landing by anyone under 15, with shoulder height below backrest, or holding an infant
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.17; CFM Rev 3.3 p.42

items.label: Pilot table
items.value: Stowed for taxi, takeoff and landing

items.label: Towing
items.value: Braking under tow may cause structural damage / nose gear collapse; if applied, inspect before next flight

items.label: Cargo fire bottle
items.value: Metered bottle 78 or 110 min (placard in cargo compartment); Flexjet fleet: 110 min
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.18; CTH Rev 2.5 p.21

items.label: Single-engine taxi
items.value: Not permitted for normal operations; taxi with both engines
items.cite: CFM Rev 3.3 p.82; CFM Rev 3.3 p.96

items.label: Souls on board
items.value: 13 souls total (11 pax, 2 crew)

items.label: Passenger seats
items.value: 8 seats (9 on P600)

conflict.other_value: P500 9 seats; P600 12 seats (8 to 12 passengers)
conflict.note: CFM p.82 and CTH p.56 list different seat counts. Ask instructor.

items.label: Lap children
items.value: 2 (per Crew Awareness Guide)

items.label: Life rafts
items.value: P500: 1 · P600: 2 (9 souls each), in aft storage compartment

conflict.other_value: P500: 1 raft in aft storage closet, 13-soul capacity · P600: 2 rafts in the forward storage closet, 9 souls each
conflict.note: The cockpit setup checklist (p.18) and passenger limitations (p.82) differ on P500 raft capacity and P600 raft location. Ask instructor.

items.label: Life vests
items.value: 1 at each seat; no additional life vests

conflict.other_value: Nine: one at each seat plus one in the lavatory vanity top drawer
conflict.note: p.82 says no additional vests; p.18 lists an extra vest in the lavatory. Ask instructor.

items.label: Brake temperature
items.value: Green range before takeoff

items.label: Last 1,000 ft of climb/descent
items.value: ≤ 1,000 fpm (company, TCAS)
items.cite: CFM Rev 3.3 p.83; CFM Rev 3.3 p.89

items.label: Fuel tanks
items.value: P500: 2 wing tanks · P600: wing tanks + FWD aux + ventral (VTRL) aux; aux tanks pressurized by engine/APU bleed, feed the wings only
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.17; CTH Rev 2.5 p.56

items.label: Approach category (straight-in)
items.value: P500 CAT B · P600 CAT C (all circle as CAT C)

items.label: Length
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.55; CTH Rev 2.5 p.16

items.label: Life rafts / O2 masks
items.value: P500 1 raft, 13 pax masks · P600 2 rafts, 14 pax masks

items.label: P600-only datalink
items.value: ACARS and CPDLC currently only on P600; XM weather unavailable on P600
items.cite: CTH Rev 2.5 p.17; CTH Rev 2.5 p.18

items.label: Galley/cabin door
items.value: Disabled OPEN is a P600 AFM limitation

items.label: Lav door switch
items.value: Electric lav door switch in cockpit on S/N 10070 and subsequent (lav emergency exit)

items.label: CG envelopes
items.value: Different per model (see weights category)
